advice: structured_data_schema: instruction.md says 'writes per-counterparty byte totals to settlement.csv' but does not specify the CSV schema (column names: asn, total_bytes, their types, or sort order). The schema is only discoverable by reading settle.py source code, not from the instruction itself.

test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs scapy==2.5.0, but grep finds no usage of scapy anywhere in app/ or tests/. Scapy is not needed by the settlement application or its supporting modules (all parsing uses struct/socket). This test-unrelated or stray dependency is baked into the image rather than being isolated to the test environment.
